decision: Model: eps-acura-integra-de-v29.glb from the Drive bundle Epsilon-final-GLBs-2026-10-15.zip, not the site repo's eps-acura-integra-de-v8.glb
why: Attaching IllumaestheticJ/Epsilon-Site was refused by the session's permission check, and the request did not come from the owner directly, so I did not work round it. The Drive bundle is the source the Civic reel used (cars.yaml). It has the same nodes the brief lists (front lip, fender flares, side skirts, rear spats, duckbill, sport wing). Whether it differs from the site's v8 is unchecked.

decision: Prices: store list prices (compare-at) Front Lip 285, Fender Flares 800, Side Skirts 400, Rear Spats 175, Trunk Lip 300, Rear Wing 1000; wallet 4,270 with the game's suspension 750 and rims 560
why: products.json is in the site repo (not reachable); the same figures were read from the store through the Shopify connector, where they are the compare-at prices and match the brief's. Civic rule: painted parts cost the painted price. Entrance colour is Platinum White Pearl, so Trunk Lip and Sport Wing are charged at their Platinum White Pearl variants. Lip, flares, skirts and spats are sold in polyurethane only, so their single price is charged though they are shown paint matched. The store was running lower sale prices that day (199.50/400/280/105/240/850); not used.

decision: Colours: enters in Platinum White Pearl, respray list is the ten DE4/DE5 factory colours the store sells painted parts in, ends on the lookbook grey #848586 (gloss) lettered Urban Gray Pearl
why: Lookbook has no paint list for this car. White is a colour the catalogue paints parts in, and white to grey makes the respray read. #848586 gloss is the lookbook colour; of the factory greys a flat mid grey is Urban Gray Pearl (Liquid Carbon is a darker metallic), which is my inference, not a fact from the files. Swatch colours other than white, Lunar Silver and the final grey are my approximations.

Honda and Acura are Dinka in GTA (official). No official counterpart of the 2023+ Integra was found (web search; the wiki hosts are not reachable from here). The Dinka Chavos is the Dinka saloon the GTA Wiki lists as Integra-based (older DB generation; another wiki says TSX), so it is the closest official name; applying it to this generation is my choice. Blista not reused. '25 because Urban Gray Pearl is a later-year colour; the year is my choice of a real DE4 year.

decision: Views: Front Lip on F, Fender Flares on a new high rear three-quarter camera R (second capture 16860, Rear Bed / Accessories), Side Skirts on D, Rear Spats on E, Trunk Lip and Rear Wing on A, suspension S, wheels W; Civic cameras reused unchanged
why: Integra and Civic sedan are within 5 cm in length, width and wheelbase and the GLBs share one frame, so the Civic cameras cover the game's car the same way (checked by overlay). The flares needed their own view showing an arch: R shows the rear arch and the whole flank; camera fitted by scoring uncovered game-car area with a silhouette projector (tools/sil.py): 3.7 % uncovered. Frozen frame there because a mechanic stands in the background.

decision: Timeline 28.2 s: part screens 1.67 s, list beats 0.47 s, respray 2.6 s
why: Nine purchases instead of seven, each with full navigation. The Honey FM bed on the Civic reel was 26.8 s and must not be cut or looped; kept as short as the pop-up and purchase sound allow. Radio file was not available in this session.

decision: 6-spoke wheel rebuilt here from the TE37 scan (tools/wheel_build.py: oriented and split rim/tyre by radius in numpy, 160k triangles each)
why: wheel6_hd_scantyre.glb was not in Dropbox and the site's te37_wheel.py is in the unreachable repo. Same scan, same triangle budget, own script. The Integra model's stock wheels are already a dark 6-spoke; the bought wheels are bronze so the change reads.
